# Logixia

> Logixia is a TypeScript-first logging library for Node.js, NestJS and edge runtimes. It combines structured logging, async-context request trace IDs, built-in redaction, OpenTelemetry correlation and multi-destination export (console, rotating files, databases, cloud log services, OTLP, webhooks) in one package with three runtime dependencies. MIT licensed.

Install: `npm install logixia`

## Documentation

- [Home](https://logixia.github.io/logixia/): overview and quick start
- [Getting started](https://logixia.github.io/logixia/guide/getting-started): install and first logger
- [Guide](https://logixia.github.io/logixia/guide/): full documentation
- [Articles](https://logixia.github.io/logixia/articles/): practical guides and recipes
